title: gelseminum chrysotrichum
intro: Gelseminum chrysotrichum, commonly known as Yellow Stag's Horn, is a plant species in the family Gelsemiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Stag's Horn include its ability to stimulate the nervous system and induce sweating, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
